incident-bot: ALERT: latency_slo_breach on /v1/generate p95/p99 exceeded thresholds in us-west-2
Avery (oncall): seeing p95 ~450ms (baseline ~120ms), p99 ~2.8s. Streaming tail stalls increasing. Paging spikes correlate with KV cache evictions.
Marta (runtime): checking KV metrics now — eviction rate jumped ~3x at 08:12 UTC. Prefill hit-rate dropped, decode CPU stayed flat. Looks like fragmentation on slab-12.
Luisa (infra): any node-wide OOMs or reallocs? infra metrics show slab shrink events on a subset of GPU hosts after background compaction.
Ravi (sre): @Luisa can you post the host list for slab-12? I want to see if shards are uneven.
Luisa (infra): hosts: gpu-w-12[3-9].usw2.internal (7 nodes). CPU/gpu memory usage: avg 78% but two hosts at 96% due to slab hotspots.
Avery (oncall): customer impact estimate? error rates OK, but single-turn streaming stalls cause retries. Early estimate ~4% of live streaming sessions affected, mostly >16k token histories.
Marta (runtime): digging into request traces — prefill path dominates for long-context chats. Prefill eviction vs decode imbalance: prefill writes are large and evict smaller decode entries, causing thrash.
Avery (oncall): so prefill is thrashing the cache, evicting decode entries needed for low-latency tail. That matches the streaming stalls.
Ravi (sre): mitigation options: 1) temporarily reduce prefill concurrency/priority 2) increase slab allocation for slab-12 3) route long-context chats to fallback model variant with smaller KV footprint.
Marta (runtime): I can flip prefill throttle flag to 0.6 (from 1.0) via runtime config rollout. It will reduce prefill workers and should reduce eviction pressure. Patch ready.
Avery (oncall): do it. Also prepare a canary route to model-compact for long contexts.
Marta (runtime): applying config now:

# runtime config
prefill_concurrency: 0.6
prefill_priority_weight: 0.4
kv_evict_threshold: 0.82

Marta (runtime): rolling across shard set A first (gpu-w-12[3-5])
deploy-bot: Deploy started by Marta to runtime-configs/prefill-throttle rollout_id=roll-7123
Marta (runtime): canary passed on shard set A, eviction rate down ~45% there, p95 improved ~30% for those hosts.
Luisa (infra): increasing slab allocation on gpu-w-12[6-7] now (one-off) to rebalance. Running `slabctl rebalance --target slab-12 --nodes 6,7`.
Ravi (sre): good. I'm also enabling a temporary routing rule to fall back to model-compact for streaming sessions with history > 12k tokens:

# routing rule
if request.history_tokens > 12000:
  route -> model-compact-v2
  timeout 6s

Avery (oncall): notify support and customer success: low-latency degradation but no 5xxs, some sessions experienced stalls >2s. Tag customers with heavy usage.
Avery (oncall): @Ravi please take next 30m for oncall ownership while I prep post-incident summary.
Ravi (sre): taking it. I'll monitor p95/p99, eviction rates, and streaming error/latency dashboards.
Marta (runtime): full rollout to remaining shards in 8m. Prefill eviction pressure reduced cluster-wide by ~38% after full rollout.
Ravi (sre): p95 clusterwide now ~160ms (back near baseline), p99 down to ~900ms. Streaming stalls reduced significantly — rate of stalls dropped to ~0.6%.
Luisa (infra): slab rebalance completed. No host OOMs. Background compaction logs looked normal.
Avery (oncall): customer impact: initial window (~08:10-08:24 UTC) affected ~4% sessions; mitigation removed majority of impact. No SLO credits expected but note for postmortem.
Marta (runtime): root cause hypothesis: KV slab fragmentation + large prefill writes created eviction churn that disproportionately removed small decode entries needed at tail. Two hosts had hotspotting due to uneven shard mapping.
Ravi (sre): short-term actions: keep prefill_concurrency at 0.6 for 24h, monitor eviction metric; leave routing fallback in place for 2h. Long-term: add shard rebalancer to avoid slab hotspots and prioritize decode entries over prefill when eviction pressure > threshold.
Avery (oncall): post-incident items assigned:
- Marta: implement decode-priority eviction policy (due EOD)
- Luisa: add auto-rebalance runbook for slab hotspots (due 48h)
- Ravi: draft customer impact blurb and add to incidents log (due 2h)
Avery (oncall): handing off active monitoring to @Ravi. Ping me if p99 > 1.5s or eviction rate rebounds.
Ravi (sre): acknowledged — monitoring, alerts adjusted (added an alert on eviction_rate > 1.8x baseline).
incident-bot: INCIDENT: severity=sev3 created by Avery at 7123456790, linked to runbook kv-fragmentation
Avery (oncall): closing thread once Ravi confirms stable for 1h.
Ravi (sre): will update in 1h. Current state: stable, mitigation in place, metrics trending down.
